about_the_game:
Eliminate All Targets with Just a Few Bullets!

This is the core element of the game.

※ How do you destroy every target?

By using ricochet shots, you can eliminate all targets.

※ Is this just another ricochet shooting game?

What sets this game apart is that the player creates the ricochet angles themselves.

You can move and rotate reflective barriers to design your own ricochet paths.
By chaining these barriers together, you can create complex trajectories—allowing you to wipe out multiple targets with a single bullet.

※ So, is creating a lot of ricochet paths with one bullet always the right answer?

No! The map is filled with various environmental objects that can either help or hinder the player.

You must strategically use or overcome these elements while carefully firing each bullet to destroy all targets.

※ Won’t this game cause fatigue for the player?

Not at all!
The challenge of strategic planning is rewarded with visceral impact, satisfying action, and explosive visual effects—delivering a rush of catharsis.
This is the true fun of the game!
